p.title: v59.97 seven more change sites take their sign, colour and bar from the printed value
p.symptom: The briefing move bars and the Korea theme list could print -0.0% or +0.0%; the Korea flow columns, the screener validation IC and record bars, the theme playbook columns and table, the portfolio backtest active return, the theme sector performance bars and the screener inspector 1-month move coloured a value that prints as zero as rising (or, for a tiny negative, falling), and the validation IC value could print -0.000.
p.root_cause: Each site chose the sign or the up/down class from the raw value (>= 0, > 0) instead of the value rounded to the digits it prints, so the class and the text disagreed for values that round to zero.
p.fix: Each site computes the direction once with directionOf(value, digits) at the digits its text prints and prints with signedText; a flat value gets no up/down class (the backtest KPI uses its existing is-plain), a flat IC or record bar draws no fill, and a zero net-buy column gets neither colour.
p.violated_rule: The sign, colour and direction word of a change follow the printed value (src/domain/shared/number.js, v58.80).
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check v59.97 block renders the screener inspector, the portfolio backtest lab and the validation IC bars with values that round to zero and with real moves, and fails on a sign or up/down class for a flat value.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs exit 0; each of the three new probes fails with its source file restored to the previous version; node scripts/ci-desktop-continuity-check.mjs exit 0. Not checked in a browser.

changelog: **Printed sign at seven more sites ({P}):** the briefing move bars, Korea participation, screener validation bars, theme playbook, portfolio backtest active return, sector performance bars and the screener inspector move now show a value that rounds to zero as flat, with no sign and no rising or falling colour.
note: v59.97: remaining raw-sign sites follow the printed value
